Device Description The Spartan eCoil™ System is a mechanically
detachable embolic coil system that consists of an
embolic coil (the Spartan eCoil™) attached to a
delivery wire with a fluoroscopic marker band and the
system is housed in an introducer sheath. The system
is provided sterile and requires no additional
equipment to be employed by the user.
2

Spartan Micro Inc. eCoilTM 510K Traditional 510(K) Premarket Notification
Indications for Use The Spartan eCoil™ System is indicated for the
endovascular embolization of intracranial aneurysms
and other neurovascular abnormalities, such as
arteriovenous malformations and arteriovenous
fistulae. The Spartan eCoil™ System is also indicated
for arterial and venous embolizations in the peripheral
vasculature.
Summary of
The Spartan eCoilTM System is designed to deliver,
Technological
deploy and detach embolic coils of various sizes,
Characteristics
shapes and profiles and to embolize or occlude blood
flow in vascular abnormalities of the neurovascular and
peripheral vessels. As such, the system is constructed
of implant grade materials. The system comes in 57
different configurations, two (2) shape configurations
and a range of primary and secondary diameters and
coil lengths. The Spartan eCoilTM System is designed
to work with market available microcatheters with
minimum working inner diameters of at least 0.017”.
The Delivery Wire includes a radiopaque marker used
as a positioning reference.
Conclusion Based on the indications for use, technological
characteristics, materials, required performance
testing, principles of operation, anatomical site, safety
characteristics and comparison to the predicate
device, Spartan’s eCoil™ System has been shown to
be substantially equivalent to the legally marketed
predicate device.

equipment to be employed by the user.

Device Description The Spartan eCoil™ System is a mechanically
detachable embolic coil system that consists of an
embolic coil (the Spartan eCoil™) attached to a
delivery wire with a fluoroscopic marker band and the
system is housed in an introducer sheath. The system
is provided sterile and requires no additional
equipment to be employed by the user.
2

endovascular embolization of intracranial aneurysms
and other neurovascular abnormalities, such as
arteriovenous malformations and arteriovenous
fistulae. The Spartan eCoil™ System is also indicated
for arterial and venous embolizations in the peripheral
vasculature.
Summary of
The Spartan eCoilTM System is designed to deliver,

deploy and detach embolic coils of various sizes,

flow in vascular abnormalities of the neurovascular and

of implant grade materials. The system comes in 57
different configurations, two (2) shape configurations
and a range of primary and secondary diameters and
coil lengths. The Spartan eCoilTM System is designed
to work with market available microcatheters with
